assertions.assertion: Explains that DefaultAccessTokenRetriever is internal in v4 and cannot be inherited
assertions.rationale: It infers and states the class was made internal/sealed in v4, which is why inheritance no longer works.
It only vaguely mentions 'an interface such as IAccessTokenRetriever (or similar)' and never actually implements it; its concrete solution is a DelegatingHandler.

assertions.assertion: Shows registration via WithAccessTokenRetriever<T>() on the remote API endpoint
assertions.rationale: No WithAccessTokenRetriever<T>() registration is shown; it registers a delegating handler on the HttpClient instead.

assertions.assertion: Mentions AccessTokenResult and its implementations (BearerTokenResult, DPoPTokenResult, NoAccessTokenResult, or AccessTokenRetrievalError)
assertions.rationale: AccessTokenResult and its implementations are never mentioned.
